intro: The Glyphic Letter is a formal summons delivered to novice human mages inside Northshire Valley by Marshal McBride. Written under the arcane seal of Khelden Bremen, the note calls promising spellcasters into Northshire Abbey to begin their formal tutelage in the arcane arts.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, friend. It appears to be a letter sealed with the insignia of Khelden, our local mage trainer. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hello, friend. I am Khelden. Is there something I can do for you?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Haha, I knew my note would not dissuade you from your path. So, you're prepared then, are you? Prepared to accept your fate? Prepared to challenge the gods and any other forces that stand before you in the pursuit of knowledge and power?
I will not lie, friend, you will be feared as much as respected. But also know this, I will be here for you when you need training. Simply seek me out as you grow more powerful.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
